abstract: Conventional price indexes partially address product heterogeneity. This paper considers the variety and quality of products in each market, the combination of region and year, and constructs panel price indexes using household scanner data on non‐alcoholic beverages in urban China. By comparing our panel price indexes to a conventional one, we find that ignoring product heterogeneity could largely underestimate the cross‐market price differences for non‐alcoholic beverages. We also find that product variety increases with urban population and income per capita, but that quality decreases with urban population, suggesting that wealthier provincial urban markets tend to have higher consumer welfare.
abstract_zh: 摘要 传统价格指数仅部分解决了产品异质性问题。本文考虑每个市场（即地区与年份的组合）中产品的品种与质量，利用中国城市非酒精饮料的家庭扫描数据构建了面板价格指数。通过将我们的面板价格指数与传统价格指数进行比较，我们发现忽略产品异质性可能会严重低估非酒精饮料的跨市场价格差异。研究还发现，产品品种随城市人口和人均收入增加而增加，但质量随城市人口增加而下降，这表明更富裕的省级城市市场往往具有更高的消费者福利。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Product heterogeneity, price index bias, and their link to provincial urban size: Evidence from urban China's beverage market
title_zh: 产品异质性、价格指数偏差及其与省级城市规模的关联：来自中国城市饮料市场的证据

abstract: Who pays bribes, and what does that reveal about gendered encounters with the state? Using seven waves of Mexico
abstract_zh: 谁在行贿，这揭示了性别化的国家接触经历？利用墨西哥七轮调查数据
title: Who Pays Bribes? Gender, Education, and Petty Corruption in Mexico, 2011-2023
title_zh: 谁在行贿？墨西哥2011-2023年性别、教育与轻微腐败研究

abstract: National public health awareness campaigns that emphasize peer-to-peer support are increasingly adopted, but evidence on the effects of peer-based programs at scale remains limited. Using quasi-experimental methods, we examine whether the prominent nationwide “R U OK? Day” campaign affects short-term mental health outcomes in Australia. Leveraging survey and administrative data, we find R U OK? Day leads to a 4% of a standard deviation increase in self-reported mental wellbeing, with the effect particularly pronounced among middle-aged males who experience a 9% of a standard deviation increase. We find no detectable effects on mental health care utilization, and we detect no statistically significant changes in suicide-related deaths in the short run, though the mortality outcomes are rare and power is limited. Our results underscore that peer-based campaigns can improve mental wellbeing, especially for high-risk groups, and point to a distinction between short-run psychological responses and outcomes that require behavioural follow-through.
abstract_zh: 强调同伴支持的国家公共卫生意识宣传活动日益普及，但关于大规模同伴项目效果的证据仍然有限。我们采用准实验方法，考察了澳大利亚全国性知名活动“你还好吗？日”对短期心理健康结果的影响。利用调查和行政数据，我们发现“你还好吗？日”使自我报告的心理健康水平提高了标准差的4%，其中中年男性的效果尤为显著，达到了标准差的9%。我们未发现该活动对心理健康服务利用产生可检测的影响，也未在短期内检测到自杀相关死亡率的统计显著变化，尽管死亡结果较为罕见且统计效力有限。我们的研究结果强调，同伴宣传活动能够改善心理健康，尤其是针对高风险群体，并指出了短期心理反应与需要行为跟进的结果之间的区别。
title: Are You Okay? Effects of a National Peer-Support Campaign on Mental Health
title_zh: 你还好吗？全国同伴支持运动对心理健康的影响

abstract: Financial advice can attenuate underinvestment but is costly, biased, and skewed towards the wealthy. AI-powered co-advisors could help deliver more scalable and affordable advice. To understand how, our vignette-based survey experiment compares the portfolio recommendations made by professional human advisors with GenAI large language models (LLMs) under biased and unbiased prompts. We document human financial advice projection whereby human advisors strongly project their own portfolios onto their clients. AI financial advice projection is prompt and model family dependent: ChatGPT is the least biased, while strong Gemini-Biased projection collapses when removing advisor demographics. LLMs are systematically more conservative than professional human advisors, recommending portfolios with lower Sharpe ratios that deliver up to 18% lower 20-year terminal wealth. However, human advisory fees erode much of this excess gain, with a 20-year breakeven fee of 1.03% p.a. Our results have direct implications for financial regulators, the advice profession, and LLM developers seeking to deploy AI-generated financial advice.
abstract_zh: 财务咨询能够缓解投资不足问题，但成本高昂、存在偏见，且偏向于富裕阶层。人工智能驱动的联合顾问可能有助于提供更具扩展性和可负担性的咨询服务。为理解这一点，我们基于情境设计的调查实验，在带有偏见和无偏见的提示下，比较了专业人类顾问与生成式人工智能大语言模型（LLMs）的投资组合建议。我们记录了人类财务咨询中的投射现象，即人类顾问强烈地将自己的投资组合偏好投射到客户身上。人工智能财务咨询的投射性则取决于提示词和模型家族：ChatGPT偏见最小，而Gemini在移除顾问人口统计信息后，其强烈的偏见性投射现象消失。LLMs系统性地比专业人类顾问更为保守，推荐的投资组合具有较低的夏普比率，导致20年期末财富最多降低18%。然而，人类咨询费用侵蚀了大部分超额收益，20年盈亏平衡费用为每年1.03%。我们的研究结果对金融监管机构、咨询行业以及寻求部署人工智能生成财务建议的LLM开发者具有直接启示。
title: Financial advice behaviour: humans versus AI
title_zh: 金融咨询行为：人类与人工智能的比较

abstract: Government schooling is ubiquitous. Average government spending on education (World Bank 2026a) as a percent of GDP was 4.04% in 2022, approximately twice the average government spending on the military in the same year (World Bank 2026b). The folk justification for such a policy is that education is an in-kind transfer of $1 from the wealthy to more than $1 worth of human capital to the impoverished. Casual conjectural history presumes that such redistribution is a result of democratization, the native demand for the “great leveler” to be provided to the masses. Simple readings of history only pass the first glance OLS (ocular least squares) tests. Augustina Paglayan, in Raised to Obey: The Rise and Spread of Mass Education (2024) gives a new lens to this routinely overlooked topic and puts the history into sharper focus. The book establishes the origins of government schooling as prior to democratization. She argues that the provision of education to the lower orders was not elite altruism but a project to indoctrinate and pacify uncooperative lower classes. She makes her argument with a comprehensive description of the timing of government schooling relative to democratization, shows relationships with the timing of civil unrest and these policies, and digs further into several major case studies in Europe and South America.
abstract_zh: 政府办学无处不在。2022年，全球政府教育支出占GDP的平均比例为4.04%（世界银行，2026a），约为同年政府军事支出平均水平的两倍（世界银行，2026b）。对此类政策的普遍辩护是，教育是一种实物转移，即从富裕阶层向贫困阶层转移1美元，却创造出价值超过1美元的人力资本。随意的推测性历史叙述假定，这种再分配是民主化的结果，是民众对“伟大均衡器”提供给大众的内在需求。对历史的简单解读仅能通过初看时的“肉眼最小二乘法”（ocular least squares）检验。奥古斯丁娜·帕格莱扬在《被教导服从：大众教育的兴起与传播》（2024）一书中，为这一常被忽视的话题提供了新的视角，使历史更加清晰。该书确立了政府办学的起源早于民主化进程。她认为，向底层民众提供教育并非精英阶层的利他主义，而是一个旨在灌输思想并安抚不合作下层阶级的项目。她通过全面描述政府办学相对于民主化的时间顺序，展示这些政策与内乱时机的关联，并深入探讨了欧洲和南美洲的几个主要案例研究来论证其观点。
title: Review of
title_zh: 《服从教育：大众教育的兴起与传播》评介——奥古斯蒂娜·帕格拉扬著

abstract: Demographers have a rich understanding of the fertility transitions that have been observed in many contexts. Yet, we lack evidence to explain whether long-run declines in fertility levels are accompanied by simultaneous changes in reproductive variability. This is important because reproductive variability—the concentration and dispersion of childbearing—may help to better explain fertility trends and predict population change. We address this gap with a case study of Brazil, which is a well-known example of fertility transition, using microdata on fertility by education for cohorts born 1910–1970. We contribute by using multiple measures of variability in completed fertility, studying how these measures change during an entire transition, how they relate to cohort fertility rates, and how this evidence varies by education. Reproductive variability declines across the Brazilian fertility transition—for measures of concentration and dispersion—although this is less evident for dispersion measures that adjust for levels of children ever born. We also find considerable differences by education and evidence that several measures of variability are predictive of fertility decline, highlighting a promising avenue for future research. Moreover, our findings suggest that conclusions based on one measure of variability may only provide a partial understanding of population dynamics.
abstract_zh: 人口学家对多国背景下观察到的生育率转变已有深入理解，但长期生育率下降是否伴随生育变异性的同步变化仍缺乏证据支撑。这一问题至关重要，因为生育变异性——即生育行为的集中度与离散度——可能有助于更精准地解释生育率趋势并预测人口变动。本研究以巴西为典型案例（该国是生育率转变的著名范例），利用1910-1970年出生队列按教育程度划分的生育微观数据填补这一空白。我们通过多重指标测量终身生育率的变异性，考察这些指标在整个转变过程中的变化规律、与队列生育率的关联性，以及不同教育群体间的差异。研究发现：巴西生育率转变期间，生育变异性（包括集中度与离散度指标）整体呈下降趋势，但经调整终身生育水平后的离散度指标变化不明显。不同教育群体间存在显著差异，且多项变异性指标对生育率下降具有预测作用，这为未来研究指明了重要方向。此外，研究结果表明，仅基于单一变异性指标得出的结论可能仅能部分反映人口动态全貌。
title: The distribution of reproduction during a fertility transition: declining spread of parenthood in Brazil
title_zh: 生育转变期间的生育分布：巴西父母身份扩散的下降

title: Europe in a Changing World: Resilience, Industrial Policy, and the Political Economy of Fragmentation
title_zh: 变化世界中的欧洲：韧性、产业政策与碎片化的政治经济学

abstract: It would be nice to have a credible book on ‘How to avoid a trade war’, but, Soumaya Keynes and Chad P Bown argue in their Introduction, in April 2026, that is an impossible dream: ‘President Trump [is] setting fire to the global economic order’ and the many choke-holds on international trade provide apparently attractive tools both for him and his opponents. ‘We reassured ourselves’, they write, ‘that ours was a reluctant guide to trade wars as well as a necessary one, given that the fighting was here to stay. We also believed that although winning could mean racing ahead of a geopolitical rival technologically, economically, and militarily, it could also mean minimizing one's own wounds. Our goals are constructive ones: to arm you with evidence of what does and doesn't work on the battlefield, and to help you see what conflict lies ahead.’
abstract_zh: 如果能有一本可信的著作，讲述“如何避免贸易战”，那将是件好事。然而，苏玛雅·凯恩斯和查德·P·鲍恩在2026年4月的引言中指出，这是一个不可能实现的梦想：“特朗普总统正在点燃全球经济秩序的火焰”，而国际贸易中的诸多制约因素，为他及其对手提供了看似诱人的工具。他们写道：“我们自我安慰说，鉴于战斗将持续下去，我们这本指南既是不得已而为之，也是必要的。我们还相信，尽管胜利可能意味着在技术、经济和军事上超越地缘政治对手，但也可能意味着最大限度地减少自身的创伤。我们的目标是建设性的：用战场上有效与无效的证据武装你，并帮助你预见前方的冲突。
title: How to Win a Trade War: An Optimistic Guide to an Anxious Global Economy. By Soumaya Keynes and Chad P. Bown, New York, NY: Simon & Schuster, 2026. 288 pp. $30.00 (hardcover). ISBN: 978‐1‐66‐822131‐0
title_zh: 如何赢得贸易战：焦虑全球经济中的乐观指南

abstract: This study empirically examines the effects of High Involvement Management ( HIM ) on establishment productivity. To achieve this it draws on a large‐scale panel data set representative of the German economy. The identification strategy exploits the bracketing property of fixed effects and lagged dependent variable models and supplements this with a selection‐on‐observables approach to estimate causal effects. Descriptive evidence indicates that decision makers value the joint implementation of the pillars of HIM ( Knowledge , Power , Information , and Rewards ), as they tend to cluster and factor analysis confirms that the included management practices reflect a single underlying management orientation. The causal analysis reveals significant productivity gains from HIM and each of its four pillars. These effects materialize for HIM adoption, HIM intensification and the presence of a HIM philosophy. While the results are in line with a monotonically increasing effect as additional pillars are adopted, no synergies between the pillars or underlying practices emerge. Finally, the findings reveal no meaningful differences in the effectiveness of HIM across establishment size, sector, knowledge intensity, or innovation strategy, suggesting that its impact is broadly consistent across organizational contexts.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本研究实证检验了高参与管理（HIM）对企业生产率的影响。为此，我们使用了代表德国经济的大规模面板数据集。识别策略利用了固定效应和滞后因变量模型的边界特性，并辅以基于可观测变量的选择方法以估计因果效应。描述性证据表明，决策者重视HIM四大支柱（知识、权力、信息与奖励）的联合实施，因为这些支柱往往呈现聚类特征，且因子分析证实所包含的管理实践反映了一种单一的基础管理导向。因果分析显示，HIM及其四大支柱均能带来显著的生产率提升。这些效应体现在HIM的采纳、强化以及HIM理念的存在上。尽管结果与采纳更多支柱时效应单调递增的规律一致，但各支柱或基础实践之间并未显现协同效应。最后，研究发现HIM的有效性在企业规模、行业、知识密集度或创新战略方面不存在显著差异，表明其影响在不同组织情境中具有广泛一致性。
title: The Productivity Effect of High Involvement Management: Causal Evidence From Germany
title_zh: 高参与管理的生产率效应：来自德国的因果证据

abstract: This article uses labor force surveys from 160 countries to build a new microdatabase on hours worked covering 97% of the world population in cross section. We also construct time series spanning over 20 years in 86 countries. Hours worked per adult slightly decline with GDP per capita but are weakly correlated with development overall. Hours worked by the young (aged 15–19) and elderly (aged 60+) fall with development, driven entirely by growing school attendance and public pension coverage. Hours worked among prime-age adults (aged 20–59) are stable with development but undergo a great gender reshuffling: falling hours per male worker have been exactly offset by increases in female labor force participation in many countries. Labor income taxes are strongly negatively related to hours worked across countries. This correlation is attenuated when controlling for social spending and disappears when further controlling for working hours regulations. Both social spending and working hours regulations are associated with lower hours worked.
abstract_zh: 本文利用来自160个国家的劳动力调查，构建了一个覆盖全球97%人口的工时微观数据库（横截面数据）。同时，我们建立了涵盖86个国家、跨度超过20年的时间序列数据。成年人平均工时随人均GDP增长略有下降，但总体而言与经济发展水平的相关性较弱。青少年（15-19岁）和老年人（60岁以上）的工时随经济发展而减少，这完全是由入学率和公共养老金覆盖率的提高所驱动的。壮年劳动力（20-59岁）的工时随经济发展保持稳定，但经历了显著的性别结构重组：在许多国家，男性工人工时的下降恰好被女性劳动参与率的上升所抵消。劳动所得税与各国工时呈显著负相关。当控制社会支出后，这一相关性减弱；进一步控制工时法规后，该相关性消失。社会支出和工时法规均与较低的工时水平相关。
title: Global Working Hours
title_zh: 全球工时

abstract: I document robust U.S. and international evidence that aggregate corporate cash savings negatively forecast future excess market returns, with economic uncertainty an important driver of this relation. In a calibrated neoclassical dynamic model featuring precautionary savings, I show that fixed financing costs, firm exit, and an uncertainty-driven time-varying price of risk are crucial to replicating this return predictability. The model further implies that the well-known positive return predictive power of aggregate accruals is largely attributable to aggregate cash savings, and the data support this implication.
abstract_zh: 我记录了美国及国际上的有力证据，表明总体企业现金储蓄对未来超额市场回报具有负向预测作用，其中经济不确定性是这一关系的重要驱动因素。在一个包含预防性储蓄的校准新古典动态模型中，我展示了固定融资成本、企业退出以及由不确定性驱动的时变风险价格，对于复现这种回报可预测性至关重要。该模型进一步暗示，总体应计项目众所周知的正面回报预测能力在很大程度上归因于总体现金储蓄，而数据支持了这一推论。
title: Aggregate corporate savings, economic uncertainty, and future stock returns
title_zh: 企业总储蓄、经济不确定性与未来股票收益

abstract: We study whether economic narratives extracted from financial news predict crude oil returns. Using 1.22 million articles from The Wall Street Journal spanning from 1986 to 2022, we apply seeded latent Dirichlet allocation (sLDA) to measure 14 time-varying narrative topics. The empirical results show that narrative topics, including war narratives, outperform traditional predictive models in forecasting crude oil returns. The results remain robust after controlling for standard macroeconomic variables, financial market variables, and uncertainty measures. In addition, we identify the economic mechanisms through which narrative economics contributes to crude oil predictability. Specifically, narrative topics operate by affecting real economic activity, uncertainty, and crude oil supply shocks.
abstract_zh: 本文研究从财经新闻中提取的经济叙事是否能够预测原油收益。基于1986年至2022年间《华尔街日报》的122万篇文章，我们采用种子潜在狄利克雷分配（sLDA）方法，测度了14个时变叙事主题。实证结果表明，包括战争叙事在内的叙事主题在预测原油收益方面优于传统预测模型。在控制标准宏观经济变量、金融市场变量及不确定性指标后，该结果依然稳健。此外，我们识别了叙事经济学对原油可预测性产生影响的经济机制：具体而言，叙事主题通过影响实际经济活动、不确定性及原油供给冲击发挥作用。
title: Narrative topics and oil
title_zh: 叙事主题与石油

abstract: We examine the effect of media freedom on public expenditure efficiency using a panel of 134 advanced and developing countries from 1994 to 2016. Our findings provide robust evidence that greater media freedom significantly enhances government spending efficiency. This effect is more pronounced in countries with higher levels of democracy, per capita income, human capital, internet access, and strong fiscal rules. Furthermore, we show that media freedom primarily influences efficiency through reduced corruption, increased transparency and accountability in the public sector, and stronger electoral competition. These results underscore the vital role of media freedom in fostering good governance and efficient public resource allocation, particularly in a context where press freedom is declining and fiscal constraints are tightening.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文利用1994年至2016年间134个发达与发展中国家的面板数据，考察了媒体自由对公共支出效率的影响。研究结果提供了稳健证据，表明更高的媒体自由显著提升了政府支出效率。这一效应在民主水平更高、人均收入更高、人力资本更丰富、互联网接入更普及以及财政规则更严格的国家中更为显著。此外，我们证明媒体自由主要通过减少腐败、增强公共部门的透明度与问责制以及强化选举竞争来影响效率。这些结果凸显了媒体自由在促进善治和高效公共资源配置中的关键作用，尤其是在新闻自由日益受限、财政约束不断收紧的背景下。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Press freedom and government spending efficiency
title_zh: 新闻自由与政府支出效率

abstract: This paper examines the relationship between voter turnout and elec0737toral polarization. While much of the existing literature focuses on how polarization affects turnout, we analyze the next step in the causal chain: how turnout shapes electoral outcomes. We propose a simple theoretical model in which turnout depends on voters’ aversion to the expected governing coalition, which increases with the distance between the voter’s ideal point and the anticipated policy platform. This generates heterogeneous participation across the ideological spectrum, leading to a compositional reweighting of the electorate. When the governing coalition is expected to be centrist, centrist voters are underrepresented while voters at the ideological extremes are overrepresented, resulting in higher levels of observed electoral polarization. We test the theoretical predictions empirically, using municipality-level data from Dutch general elections. The results show that turnout has systematically heterogeneous effects across parties depending on their ideological position, with more extreme parties benefiting disproportionately from lower turnout. Consistent with the theory, lower turnout is associated with higher levels of electoral polarization. These findings highlight a compositional mechanism through which turnout influences electoral outcomes, resulting in a distorted picture in which electoral polarization exceeds what would be implied by the underlying distribution of ideological preferences in the population.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了选民投票率与选举极化之间的关系。现有文献多聚焦于极化如何影响投票率，而我们则分析因果链条中的下一步：投票率如何塑造选举结果。我们提出了一个简洁的理论模型，其中投票率取决于选民对预期执政联盟的反感程度，这种反感随选民理想点与预期政策立场之间的距离增加而增强。这导致意识形态光谱上的参与不均，进而引起选民构成上的重新加权。当预期执政联盟趋于中间派时，中间派选民的代表性不足，而意识形态极端选民则过度代表，从而使得观察到的选举极化水平升高。我们利用荷兰大选的市级数据对理论预测进行了实证检验。结果显示，投票率对不同政党具有系统性异质性影响，取决于其意识形态立场，极端政党在低投票率下获益不成比例。与理论一致，较低的投票率与较高的选举极化水平相关联。这些发现揭示了一种构成性机制，通过该机制投票率影响选举结果，导致选举极化超过人口中潜在意识形态偏好分布所隐含水平的扭曲景象。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Turnout and the distortion of representation: the case of electoral polarization
title_zh: 投票率与代表性扭曲：选举极化的案例

abstract: Agriculture accounts for 11 per cent of EU greenhouse gas emissions, yet sectoral emissions have stagnated over the past two decades. This paper evaluates carbon pricing in EU agriculture by integrating stochastic yield variability into the CAPRI model. We assess how different carbon price levels affect emissions and outcome uncertainty. Results show that carbon pricing reduces emissions, and higher price levels are associated with lower uncertainty in policy outcomes. While expected results remain similar to deterministic simulations, stochastic modeling reveals greater regional and sectoral heterogeneity. These findings highlight the importance of accounting for production risk when designing agricultural climate policies.
abstract_zh: 摘要农业占欧盟温室气体排放的11%，但过去二十年间该行业排放量停滞不前。本文通过将随机产量波动性纳入CAPRI模型，评估了欧盟农业中的碳定价机制。我们分析了不同碳价水平对排放量和结果不确定性的影响。结果表明，碳定价能够减少排放，且更高的碳价水平与政策结果不确定性的降低相关。尽管预期结果与确定性模拟相似，但随机建模揭示了更大的区域和行业异质性。这些发现强调了在设计农业气候政策时考虑生产风险的重要性。
title: Beyond determinism: Accounting for weather variability in the carbon pricing debate for EU agriculture
title_zh: 超越决定论：欧盟农业碳定价辩论中天气变率的考量

abstract: Studies that analyze the transmission of food prices from international to domestic markets for large sets of countries and products assume that price relationships are time‐invariant. However, studies that look in detail at individual countries and products show that countries respond to increasing international food prices with measures that increase the insulation of their domestic markets and thus weaken international‐to‐domestic price transmission. We analyze relationships between international prices and a large set of domestic prices for wheat, yellow and white maize, and rice using a smooth‐transition error correction model. This specification relaxes the assumption of time‐invariant price transmission by allowing price relationships and domestic market insulation to vary over time depending on international price levels. The results confirm that international‐to‐domestic price transmission weakens in many countries during periods of high international prices, such as 2007/08 and 2022. Our findings highlight a collective action problem: as more countries insulate, the global trading system's capacity to buffer shocks diminishes, amplifying volatility and food security risks.
abstract_zh: 摘要 针对多国多产品国际与国内食品价格传导关系的研究，通常假设价格关系具有时间不变性。然而，聚焦单个国家与产品的细化研究表明，各国面对国际食品价格上涨时，会采取增强国内市场隔离度的措施，从而削弱国际与国内价格之间的传导效应。本文采用平滑转换误差修正模型，分析国际价格与小麦、黄玉米、白玉米及大米等大量国内价格之间的关系。该模型通过允许价格关系及国内市场隔离度随国际价格水平动态变化，突破了时间不变性假设的局限。研究结果证实，在国际价格高涨时期（如2007/08年度及2022年），许多国家的国际-国内价格传导效应显著减弱。这一发现揭示了集体行动困境：随着更多国家采取隔离措施，全球贸易体系缓冲冲击的能力持续下降，进而加剧价格波动与粮食安全风险。
title: Food Price Crises and the Insulation of Domestic Grain Markets
title_zh: 粮食价格危机与国内谷物市场的隔离

abstract: We build an experiment to uncover the bandit-like nature of consumer behavior usually masked by the product and time aggregation of consumption data. Subjects make repeated choices between musical styles (either all familiar or unfamiliar), and post-choice satisfaction is observed. We estimate Bayesian bandit models of learning taste by consuming with satiation. Our best model features decreasing random exploration, with openness being associated with higher exploration. Early exploration is more intensive in the unfamiliar treatment and persists throughout the experiment in both treatments. Overall, subjects make choices that deviate from their best prediction 61.5% of the time in the unfamiliar treatment versus 44.7% in the familiar treatment. Our model offers a rational interpretation of random utility in discrete consumer choices which does not rest on perception and/or decision errors.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一项实验，以揭示通常被消费数据的产品和时间聚合所掩盖的消费者行为的“赌博机”特性。受试者在音乐风格（全部为熟悉或全部为不熟悉）之间进行重复选择，并观察选择后的满意度。我们通过消费与饱足感来估计学习品味的贝叶斯赌博机模型。最优模型的特征是随机探索逐渐减少，而开放性则与更高的探索水平相关。在不熟悉处理组中，早期探索更为密集，且这种探索在两个处理组中均持续整个实验。总体而言，受试者在不熟悉处理组中有61.5%的时间做出了偏离其最佳预测的选择，而在熟悉处理组中这一比例为44.7%。我们的模型为离散消费者选择中的随机效用提供了一种理性解释，这种解释不依赖于感知和/或决策错误。
title: Learning by consuming in the lab
title_zh: 实验室中的消费学习

abstract: This study investigates return spillovers among gambling tokens, gambling exchange-traded funds (ETFs), and traditional financial assets using a Quantile Vector Autoregression (QVAR) framework, while evaluating portfolio diversification strategies and the role of global uncertainties. Empirical results demonstrate that connectedness across these markets intensifies significantly at extreme quantiles of the return distribution compared to median quantiles, indicating that gambling tokens function as effective diversifiers under normal market conditions. However, their diversification efficacy attenuates during periods of economic turmoil. Notably, gambling tokens exhibit robust tail risk mitigation during market downturns and recovery phases. Dynamic portfolios incorporating these tokens outperform static buy-and-hold strategies in risk management. Furthermore, Wavelet Quantile Regression (WQR) analysis reveals heterogeneous impacts of global uncertainties on return connectedness, with effects contingent on market conditions and time horizons. Specifically, uncertainty-driven spillovers are most pronounced during bearish regimes and at longer time scales. These findings underscore the importance of adaptive portfolio strategies and provide critical insights for investors seeking to balance diversification benefits with tail-risk resilience in an increasingly interconnected global financial market.
abstract_zh: 本研究采用分位数向量自回归（QVAR）框架，考察博彩代币、博彩交易所交易基金（ETF）与传统金融资产之间的收益溢出效应，同时评估投资组合多元化策略及全球不确定性的作用。实证结果表明，相较于中位数分位数，这些市场在收益分布的极端分位数处关联性显著增强，表明博彩代币在正常市场条件下可作为有效的多元化工具。然而，在经济动荡时期，其多元化效能有所减弱。值得注意的是，博彩代币在市场下行及复苏阶段展现出稳健的尾部风险缓释能力。纳入这些代币的动态投资组合在风险管理方面优于静态买入持有策略。此外，小波分位数回归（WQR）分析揭示了全球不确定性对收益关联性的异质性影响，其效应取决于市场状况与时间跨度。具体而言，不确定性驱动的溢出效应在熊市阶段及较长周期内最为显著。这些发现凸显了适应性投资组合策略的重要性，并为投资者在日益互联的全球金融市场中平衡多元化收益与尾部风险韧性提供了关键启示。
title: Extreme return connectedness among gambling tokens, gambling ETFs, and other assets: the role of global uncertainties and portfolio implications
title_zh: 赌博代币、赌博ETF及其他资产的极端收益关联性：全球不确定性的作用与投资组合影响

abstract: Digital financial inclusion strategies often assume that higher levels of education and financial literacy promote adoption of digital financial services by increasing trust. However, empirical evidence on how literacy interacts with trust remains limited, particularly across countries at different stages of digital ecosystem maturity. This study uses cross-sectional survey data collected from low-income individuals in Bangladesh and Indonesia (n = 2,000). We estimate multivariate regression models to examine the relationship between education, financial literacy, institutional trust, and mobile payment adoption, and apply Shapley value decomposition to assess the relative contribution of correlated explanatory factors. Theresults reveal substantial cross-country differences. In Bangladesh,both education and financial literacy are positively associated withmobile payment adoption. In Indonesia, a more digitally maturecontext, these relationships are weaker and in some cases reversed.Notably, higher levels.The findings challenge the assumption that financial literacy alone fosters digital financial inclusion. Policy efforts should complement education initiatives with stronger consumer protection, fraud prevention, and trust-building measures tailored to local contexts.
abstract_zh: 数字普惠金融策略通常假设，更高的教育水平和金融素养能够通过增强信任来促进数字金融服务的采纳。然而，关于素养如何与信任相互作用的实证证据仍然有限，尤其是在数字生态系统成熟度不同的国家之间。本研究利用从孟加拉国和印度尼西亚低收入群体中收集的横截面调查数据（样本量n=2,000），通过估计多元回归模型，考察教育、金融素养、制度信任与移动支付采纳之间的关系，并运用沙普利值分解法评估相关解释因素的相对贡献。结果显示，两国之间存在显著差异。在孟加拉国，教育和金融素养均与移动支付采纳呈正相关；而在数字生态更为成熟的印度尼西亚，这种关系较弱，甚至在某些情况下出现逆转。值得注意的是，更高水平的金融素养并未显著增强信任对采纳的促进作用。这些发现挑战了“仅凭金融素养即可推动数字金融包容”的假设。政策制定应结合教育举措，同时加强消费者保护、欺诈防范以及因地制宜的信任建设措施。
title: Who uses mobile payment apps in developing countries? Literacy, education, and the role of trust
title_zh: 发展中国家谁在使用移动支付应用？识字率、教育与信任的作用

abstract: Small, Medium, Large: How the Government Made the U.S. into a Manufacturing Powerhouse. By Coleen A. Dunlavy. Cambridge, UK and Hoboken, NJ: Polity Press, 2024. Pp. xii, 226. 24.00 ebook. - Volume 86 Issue 2
abstract_zh: 《小、中、大：政府如何将美国打造成制造业强国》。作者：Coleen A. Dunlavy。剑桥（英国）与霍博肯（新泽西州）：Polity Press出版社，2024年。第xii+226页。电子书24.00美元。——第86卷第2期

title_zh: 小、中、大：政府如何将美国打造成制造业强国

abstract: It Takes Money to Make MPs: Evidence from 160 Years of British Campaign Spending —ADDENDUM - Volume 86 Issue 2
abstract_zh: 要成为议员需要花钱：来自英国160年竞选开支的证据——增补 第86卷第2期
title: It Takes Money to Make MPs: Evidence from 160 Years of British Campaign Spending —ADDENDUM
title_zh: 议员竞选需要金钱：来自英国160年竞选支出的证据——附录

abstract: We extend the heteroskedasticity IV estimator of Rigobon and Sack (2004) to multiple monetary policy shocks by imposing recursive zero restrictions on the impact matrix. Unlike high-frequency identification, the approach requires neither intraday tick data nor precise announcement timestamps, making it applicable to countries and historical periods where such data are unavailable. Applied to US FOMC announcements, we find causal effects similar to those of high-frequency identification. The heteroskedasticity-based instrument passes weak-instrument tests for the target shock, whereas results are mixed for high-frequency surprises. For the path shock, we obtain strong instruments for the majority of specifications and the underlying shock series is highly correlated with the high-frequency counterpart.
abstract_zh: 我们将Rigobon与Sack（2004）的异方差性IV估计量扩展至多重货币政策冲击，通过对影响矩阵施加递归零约束实现。与高频识别方法不同，该方法既不需要日内逐笔交易数据，也无需精确的公告时间戳，因此适用于缺乏此类数据的国家及历史时期。应用于美国联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）公告时，我们发现的因果效应与高频识别结果相似。基于异方差性的工具变量在目标冲击的弱工具检验中表现良好，而高频意外冲击的检验结果则参差不齐。对于路径冲击，我们在大多数设定下获得了强工具变量，且其潜在冲击序列与高频对应序列高度相关。
title: Multiple monetary policy shocks from daily data: A heteroskedasticity IV approach
title_zh: 基于日度数据的多重货币政策冲击：异方差性工具变量方法

abstract: Teamwork can either cure or create procrastination. When present-biased teammates break a shared plan, the guilt of shirking depends on whether the partner acts too: shared inaction diffuses responsibility, while unilateral inaction betrays an acting partner. A team can therefore act when each member alone would delay, and stall when each alone would act. The harmful case is a coordination trap, arising only when both members are conditional starters who wait for each other. A single self-starter — one who acts whatever the partner does — breaks it, inducing exactly the outcome a committed visible leader would. A self-starter is an endogenous leader: heterogeneity in follow-through substitutes for leadership.
abstract_zh: 团队合作既能治愈拖延，也可能催生拖延。当具有现时偏见的队友违背共同计划时，内疚感取决于伙伴是否同样行动：共同不作为分散了责任，而单方面不作为则辜负了正在行动的伙伴。因此，团队可能在每个成员单独行动都会推迟的情况下采取行动，也可能在每个成员单独行动都会行动的情况下停滞不前。有害的情形是一种协调陷阱，仅当双方都是等待对方的条件启动者时才会出现。一个自我启动者——无论伙伴如何行动都采取行动的人——能够打破这一陷阱，恰好产生一个坚定的可见领导者所能带来的结果。自我启动者即内生领导者：执行力的异质性替代了领导力。
title: Procrastination traps and endogenous leadership in teams
title_zh: 团队中的拖延陷阱与内生性领导力

abstract: Setzler (2025) provides an important benchmark for merger analysis when firms exercise linked product-market and labor-market power under oligopoly and oligopsony. This note derives upward pricing pressure (UPP) screens for horizontal mergers under a different labor-market institution: unionization. In an efficient-bargaining model with Stone-Geary union utility, a price change that diverts sales to the merger partner may also affect that partner’s employment, wages, or workers’ outside options. Whereas product-labor links amplify merger harm in Setzler’s oligopsony benchmark, union-mediated effects can make product-side screens too lenient or too aggressive, thereby reversing whether a one-sided screen flags the merger.
abstract_zh: Setzler（2025）为企业在寡头垄断与寡头买方垄断下行使关联的产品市场与劳动力市场势力时的并购分析提供了重要基准。本文在另一种劳动力市场制度——工会化——下推导横向并购的向上定价压力（UPP）筛查指标。在具有Stone-Geary工会效用的有效谈判模型中，将销售转移至并购合作伙伴的价格变化也可能影响该合作伙伴的就业、工资或工人的外部选择。尽管在Setzler的寡头买方垄断基准中，产品与劳动力之间的关联放大了并购损害，但工会中介效应可能使产品侧筛查指标过于宽松或过于激进，从而逆转单边筛查是否标记该并购的结论。
title: Upward pricing pressure in linked product and labor markets: Union bargaining and merger screens
title_zh: 关联产品与劳动力市场中的向上定价压力：工会谈判与并购审查

abstract: Central bank communications frequently contain information about financial-market backstops that affect monetary policy transmission. We identify these transmission protection surprises in the euro area, alongside policy stance and central bank information surprises, by exploiting heteroskedasticity in minute-by-minute asset price movements. Unlike standard factor models, our approach allows active policy dimensions and their impacts to vary across events. Event-specific decompositions quantify the narrative record and reveal substantial heterogeneity of effects across announcements. We show that transmission protection is a distinct dimension of central bank announcements, with financial-market effects separate from both policy stance and information shocks.
abstract_zh: 央行沟通中频繁包含影响货币政策传导的金融市场兜底信息。我们利用欧元区资产价格分钟级波动的异方差性，在识别政策立场与央行信息冲击的同时，识别出这些传导保护意外。与标准因子模型不同，我们的方法允许政策维度及其影响在不同事件中动态变化。基于事件特定分解的量化叙事记录显示，不同公告的影响存在显著异质性。研究表明，传导保护是央行公告的独立维度，其金融市场效应与政策立场冲击及信息冲击均存在差异。
title: The Missing Surprise: Transmission Protection in Central Bank Announcements
title_zh: 缺失的意外：央行公告中的传导保护

abstract: We explore whether experiments involving strategic interactions yield the same conclusions regardless of the environment they take place in. We do so by comparing the behavior of a group of individuals when they play the same two-person zero-sum game in both a soccer stadium (the field) and a video game (the lab). We conduct our experiment with professional soccer players and inexperienced college students to determine if the abilities acquired in the field apply to both environments. Our findings show that while both groups behave consistently with the implications of mixed strategy equilibrium in the field, their behavior rejects the theory in the lab, where both groups seem to follow a reinforcement learning model.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了涉及策略互动的实验是否在不同环境下得出相同结论。为此，我们比较了同一组个体在足球场（实地）和电子游戏（实验室）中玩相同的两人零和游戏时的行为。我们以职业足球运动员和缺乏经验的大学生为实验对象，以确定在实地获得的能力是否适用于两种环境。研究结果显示，尽管两组在实地中的行为与混合策略均衡的含义一致，但在实验室中，他们的行为却拒绝了该理论，两组似乎都遵循强化学习模型。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 248
title: Déjà Vu? When the Lab Mimics the Field
title_zh: 既视感？当实验室模拟现实世界时

abstract: Do central banks decide systematically how much to communicate when explaining their policy decisions? Using all U.S. Federal Open Market Committee policy statements since 1994, we measure communication effort through the change in Shannon entropy and estimate a forward-looking communication rule. We find that communication is systematic: the Federal Reserve communicates more when inflation is expected to exceed target and output is expected to fall below potential. This finding is robust across a variety of sensitivity exercises. We then develop a New Keynesian model with imperfect information showing that systematic communication acts as a second policy instrument, stabilizing expectations and complementing interest-rate policy, especially at the zero lower bound.
abstract_zh: 中央银行在解释其政策决策时，是否会系统性地决定沟通程度？我们利用1994年以来美国联邦公开市场委员会的所有政策声明，通过香农熵的变化衡量沟通努力程度，并估算前瞻性沟通规则。研究发现沟通具有系统性：当预期通胀将超过目标值、产出将低于潜在水平时，美联储会加强沟通。这一结论在多种敏感性检验中保持稳健。我们进一步构建包含不完全信息的新凯恩斯模型，证明系统性沟通作为第二政策工具，能够稳定预期并补充利率政策效力，尤其在零利率下限环境下效果显著。
title: Louder than Rates: The Systematic Nature of Central Bank Communication
title_zh: 比利率更响亮：央行沟通的系统性本质

abstract: We develop a general equilibrium model where loan securitization is an endogenous outcome in a credit market where information asymmetries lead to adverse selection across financial intermediaries. Securitization occurs when the resources saved by investors acquiring limited information about the risk-class of some borrowers outweigh the cost of being selected against by loan originators. This results in a time-varying market share of individually risk-priced loans held by banks, and of securitized loans held by the secondary market. We analyze the impact of conventional monetary policies and credit market policies in response to an increase in default risk, and discuss its welfare implications. Overall securitization allows more efficient funding of loans, at the expense of increased volatility in risky interest rates, consumption, and inflation over the business cycle.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个一般均衡模型，其中贷款证券化是信贷市场中信息不对称导致金融中介机构之间逆向选择的内生结果。当投资者获取部分借款人风险等级信息所节省的资源超过其被贷款发起人逆向选择所付出的成本时，证券化便会产生。这导致银行持有的个别风险定价贷款与二级市场持有的证券化贷款的市场份额随时间动态变化。我们分析了常规货币政策与信贷市场政策在应对违约风险上升时的效果，并探讨其福利影响。总体而言，证券化能够更高效地为贷款提供资金，但代价是加剧了经济周期中风险利率、消费和通胀的波动性。
title: Prime vs. Subprime: Asymmetric Information and Equilibrium Securitization in a Business Cycle Model
title_zh: 优质与次级：商业周期模型中的信息不对称与均衡证券化

abstract: We introduce a survey instrument to measure earnings risk allowing for the possibility of quitting or being fired from the current job. We find these transitions to be the key drivers of subjective risk. A link with administrative data provides multiple credibility checks and reveals that subjective earnings risk varies systematically across the population. It is also many times smaller than traditional estimates even when conditioning richly on demographics and job history. We show that subjective earnings risk can help explain why many hold limited liquid assets.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文引入了一种调查工具，用于衡量收入风险，并允许考虑当前工作可能被辞职或解雇的情况。我们发现，这些工作转换是主观风险的关键驱动因素。通过与行政数据的关联，我们进行了多项可信度检验，并揭示出主观收入风险在人群中存在系统性差异。即使在充分控制人口统计特征和工作历史的情况下，主观收入风险仍比传统估计值小很多倍。我们证明，主观收入风险有助于解释为何许多人持有的流动资产有限。
title: Subjective Earnings Risk
title_zh: 主观收入风险

abstract: Achieving development within planetary boundaries faces its most acute challenge in Sub-Saharan Africa, where rapid population growth intensifies land use pressure. Yet, it remains unclear whether, where, and to what extent population growth can decouple from land loss across the region. Here we address this gap by developing a multiscale research framework to examine population and land loss decoupling from 1990 to 2050 under the Shared Socioeconomic Pathways (SSPs). We combine Tapio elasticity analysis with a Geographically Weighted Elastic Net model to quantify decoupling at pixel, national, and biome scales. Our results show that decoupling is limited in extent and structurally weak across scales. Most pixels exhibited no change, and where change occurred, weak decoupling (WD) dominated with elasticities clustered near zero. Spatial heterogeneity is evident, with localized hotspots of strong decoupling (SD) and coupling coexist. Ecological context conditions decoupling capacity; humid and semi-humid forest systems maintaining more stable decoupling than dryland and Mediterranean systems. Over time, stronger divergence in the 1990s weakens toward a more constrained quasi-equilibrium. Future decoupling trajectories are pathway dependent. SSP1 and SSP2 stabilize WD, whereas SSP3 and SSP4 slightly increase SD prevalence while reducing weak negative decoupling. These findings indicate that land loss dynamics in SSA are shaped not by population growth alone, but by the interaction of ecological conditions, spatial scale, and socioeconomic development pathways. This emphasizes the need for land use policies that are spatially differentiated, ecologically sensitive, and aligned with long-term development pathways.
abstract_zh: 在行星边界内实现发展所面临的最严峻挑战位于撒哈拉以南非洲，那里快速的人口增长加剧了土地利用压力。然而，该地区人口增长能否与土地流失脱钩、在何处脱钩以及脱钩程度如何，目前仍不清楚。本研究通过构建一个多尺度研究框架，考察1990年至2050年间在共享社会经济路径（SSPs）下人口与土地流失的脱钩情况，以填补这一研究空白。我们将Tapio弹性分析与地理加权弹性网络模型相结合，在像元、国家和生物群落尺度上量化脱钩程度。结果表明，脱钩在范围上有限，且在跨尺度上结构薄弱。大多数像元未表现出变化，而在发生变化的区域，弱脱钩（WD）占主导地位，弹性值聚集于零附近。空间异质性明显，强脱钩（SD）与耦合的局部热点并存。生态背景条件制约着脱钩能力；湿润和半湿润森林系统比旱地和地中海系统维持更稳定的脱钩状态。随时间推移，20世纪90年代较强的分化趋势逐渐减弱，趋向于更为受限的准平衡状态。未来脱钩轨迹依赖于路径选择。SSP1和SSP2使弱脱钩趋于稳定，而SSP3和SSP4则略微提高了强脱钩的发生率，同时减少了弱负脱钩。这些发现表明，撒哈拉以南非洲的土地流失动态并非仅由人口增长单独塑造，而是生态条件、空间尺度和社会经济发展路径相互作用的结果。这强调了制定空间差异化、生态敏感且与长期发展路径相一致的土地利用政策的必要性。
title: Socioecological pathways shape the decoupling of population growth and land loss across Sub-Saharan Africa
title_zh: 社会生态路径塑造撒哈拉以南非洲人口增长与土地流失的脱钩

abstract: The ways in which governments legitimize and promote plant-rich eating remain underexplored, particularly in contexts where animal-based foods retain strong cultural and political significance. Focusing primarily on nutritional governance, this study examines the institutional mechanisms through which plant foods and plant-rich practices have been framed as objects of public intervention in Portugal since the inception of the National Program for the Promotion of Healthy Eating in 2012. Adopting a qualitative, discourse-oriented, and semiotically informed approach, the study conceptualizes public intervention as a dispositif that actively shapes meanings and norms around food. Findings show that the legitimization of plant-rich eating relies on strategically cautious discourse emphasizing health, sustainability, and heritage, while avoiding explicit advocacy of vegetarianism. The Mediterranean diet emerges as the primary legitimizing model, enabling plant foods without challenging the centrality of meat and fish. Risk prevention and responsibilization further structure these discourses, framing citizens as self-monitoring consumers. Ultimately, plant-rich eating is cautiously legitimized yet continually negotiated, absorbed into broader narratives of health, sustainability, and national identity. As the first European country to legally require the availability of vegetarian meals in public canteens, Portugal offers insights for other national contexts, particularly regarding discursive strategies, risk-based governance, the symbolic status of animal and plant products, and the role of institutional environments in normalizing plant-rich eating. These findings also resonate with developments elsewhere while highlighting context-specific dynamics.
abstract_zh: 政府如何合法化并推广植物性饮食仍是一个研究不足的领域，尤其是在动物性食品仍具有深厚文化及政治意义的背景下。本研究聚焦营养治理，考察自2012年葡萄牙启动《促进健康饮食国家计划》以来，植物性食品及植物性饮食实践被构建为公共干预对象的制度机制。采用定性、话语导向及符号学分析路径，本研究将公共干预概念化为一个积极塑造食品意义与规范的"装置"。研究发现，植物性饮食的合法化依赖于策略性谨慎话语，强调健康、可持续性与传统遗产，同时避免明确倡导素食主义。地中海饮食模式成为主要的合法化模型，既推广植物性食品又不挑战肉类与鱼类的主导地位。风险预防与责任化进一步构建了这些话语，将公民塑造为自我监控的消费者。最终，植物性饮食虽被谨慎合法化，却持续处于协商状态，被吸纳进健康、可持续性与国家认同的宏大叙事中。作为首个通过法律要求公共食堂提供素食的欧洲国家，葡萄牙为其他国家的实践提供了启示，尤其在话语策略、风险治理、动植物产品的象征地位以及制度环境对植物性饮食常态化的作用方面。这些发现亦与其他地区的发展相呼应，同时凸显了特定情境的动态特征。
title: Framing plant-rich eating: an analysis of nutritional public policies in Portugal
title_zh: 构建植物性饮食框架：葡萄牙营养公共政策分析

abstract: Optimizing grain trade patterns to conserve cropland is crucial for enhancing the “internal circulation” of grain production. This study characterized the current supply and demand dynamics for China’s three primary staple crops—wheat, maize, and rice—encompassing demand for human consumption, animal feed, and food loss and waste across the entire food supply chain. We developed a linear programming-based grain trade simulation and optimization model to determine the interprovincial trade patterns of these three crops and their virtual cropland trade structure, to assess the potential reduction in cropland requirements achieved by optimizing interprovincial grain trade patterns. We found that in profit-driven trade schemes, grain trade largely follows the principle of proximity, and major grain-producing provinces such as Henan, Shandong, and Anhui alleviate cropland resource imbalances to some extent through interprovincial trade. Optimizing trade patterns could reduce national cropland requirements by nearly 15,000 km2. Attention should also be paid to the synergistic benefits of reducing cropland requirements and reducing transport-related carbon emissions. Optimizing the grain trade structure and leveraging the production advantages of major grain-producing regions contribute to reducing cropland requirement, while simultaneously enhancing the role of land resource management in guaranteeing a stable food supply.
abstract_zh: 优化粮食贸易格局以保护耕地，对于增强粮食生产的“内循环”至关重要。本研究刻画了中国三大主要口粮作物——小麦、玉米和水稻——当前的供需动态，涵盖了人类消费需求、动物饲料需求以及整个食品供应链中的粮食损失与浪费。我们构建了一个基于线性规划的粮食贸易模拟与优化模型，以确定这三种作物的省际贸易格局及其虚拟耕地贸易结构，旨在评估通过优化省际粮食贸易格局所能实现的耕地需求减少潜力。研究发现，在利润驱动的贸易方案下，粮食贸易大体遵循就近原则，河南、山东和安徽等粮食主产省通过省际贸易在一定程度上缓解了耕地资源的不平衡。优化贸易格局可使全国耕地需求减少近15000平方公里。同时，应关注减少耕地需求与降低运输相关碳排放的协同效益。优化粮食贸易结构并发挥粮食主产区的生产优势，有助于减少耕地需求，同时增强土地资源管理在保障稳定粮食供应中的作用。

title: Reducing cropland requirement by optimizing provincial grain trade patterns in China
title_zh: 优化中国省级粮食贸易格局以减少耕地需求

abstract: This paper studies a randomized controlled trial in which undocumented Venezuelan migrants in Colombia were assigned to receive informational videos via WhatsApp encouraging registration in a regularization program. The intervention backfired. Receiving a video reduced take-up by 8 percentage points, a 15 percent decline relative to the control mean. The negative effect operated through two channels. Among individuals who watched, exposure to procedural content discouraged registration. Among those who did not engage, unsolicited contact itself reduced take-up. Both effects were concentrated among individuals at the margin of the decision to participate. These findings challenge the assumption that well-designed informational nudges are, at worst, neutral.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一项随机对照试验，其中哥伦比亚境内的无证委内瑞拉移民被随机分配接收通过WhatsApp发送的鼓励其参与正规化计划注册的信息视频。该干预措施产生了反效果。接收视频使参与率降低了8个百分点，相较于对照组均值下降了15%。这一负面效应通过两个渠道发挥作用：在观看视频的个体中，接触程序性内容抑制了注册行为；在未观看视频的个体中，未经请求的接触本身降低了参与率。两种效应均集中于处于参与决策边缘的群体。这些发现挑战了"精心设计的信息助推措施至多仅具中性效果"的假设。

title: When Digital Nudges Nag: Evidence on Program Take-up from a WhatsApp Intervention
title_zh: 当数字助推变成唠叨：来自WhatsApp干预的项目参与证据

abstract: We provide the first lender-level analysis linking two independently constructed credit supply measures: the Federal Reserve's Senior Loan Officer Opinion Survey (SLOOS) and credit card mail offers from Mintel Comperemedia. Using a matched panel of 73 banks from 2000 to 2019, we find that quarterly mail volume growth was 18 percent lower when banks reported tightening credit card lending standards, a relationship robust to including credit demand indicators. In addition, SLOOS responses on credit limits and interest rate spreads are also correlated with these terms observed in mail offers. Our findings validate both measures as informative credit supply indicators.
abstract_zh: 我们首次从银行层面出发，将两种独立构建的信贷供给指标联系起来：美联储的高级贷款官意见调查（SLOOS）与Mintel Comperemedia的信用卡邮件报价数据。基于2000年至2019年73家银行的匹配面板数据，研究发现，当银行报告收紧信用卡贷款标准时，季度邮件数量增长率降低18%，这一关系在纳入信贷需求指标后依然稳健。此外，SLOOS中关于信用额度和利差的调查结果，也与邮件报价中观察到的这些条款存在相关性。我们的发现验证了这两种指标作为有效信贷供给指标的价值。
title: The Standards Are in the Mail: Comparing Credit Card Supply Indicators
title_zh: 标准已寄出：信用卡供给指标的比较
